figure.title: Variation with lift coefficient of the aerodynamic characteristics for wing 2. (b) Drag coefficient.
figure.x_axis: Lift coefficient, CL (staggered: each Mach number has its own CL = 0, marked by a 0 label on the bottom row)
figure.y_axis: Drag coefficient, CD (common to all Mach numbers)
figure.content_note: Wing 2: 47 deg, t/c 0.06 (configuration 47deg-t06). Measured points: hollow symbols with a centre dot, one shape per Mach number, joined by faired curves. Test Mach numbers as labelled: 0.50, 0.70, 0.85, 0.90, 0.925, 0.95, 0.975, 1.00, 1.02, 1.035, 1.088, 1.10, 1.12.

scan.extraction: tools/digitize/extract_scan.py --turn cw: the page's single embedded image (page /Rotate 0), turned a quarter turn clockwise so that the sideways figure reads upright

calibration.x_definition: Common staggered axis: left frame -0.1, grid every 0.1; one 0 label every 0.2 from 0.0 (M 0.50) to 2.4 (M 1.12); then .2 .4 .6 of M 1.12 at 2.6 to 3.0 (right frame).
